profile: Palatin Technologies develops peptide and small-molecule medicines that modulate melanocortin receptors. Its principal internal focus is selective MC4R agonists for rare obesity disorders associated with the MC4R pathway, including hypothalamic obesity, Prader-Willi syndrome and Bardet-Biedl syndrome. Programs include peptide candidates and oral small molecules progressing through preclinical development. Palatin also partners or licenses other receptor-based programs, including work in retinal disease.
